summary.text: John Snyder represents District 86, parts of Martin and Palm Beach counties, in the Florida House of Representatives, to which Snyder was first elected in 2020; Snyder served as Deputy Majority Leader from 2022 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Snyder, who lives in Stuart, owns a staffing and payroll services business and served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2007 to 2012, including a deployment to Afghanistan.
Snyder holds a bachelor's degree in marketing from Indiana Wesleyan University.
